oneOf.description: Sew's own model: roles, overwrites and membership are edited in Sew (the default).
The governing App decides membership, private channels and levels (K2's sync).

The server-governed Space (named `K5 Space`), one per K2 install, owned by `k2:server`:
K2's daemon decides its structure over mgmt; no App session ever reaches it.

app_id.description: The App the Space belongs to; absent for a Space of K2's own.

governance.description:
`server` creates the server-governed Space (owner `k2:server`, slug
[`ADMIN_SPACE_SLUG`], no `app_id`, no managers, not hidden; a K2 install only). Only
`server` is accepted here (`app` is the settings switch). Absent: today's create.

hidden.description:
A hidden Space, left out of `GET /spaces`, browse, the directory and
(without the `hidden_spaces` capability) READY. Set at create only. Default `false`.

managers.description:
0–10 distinct members who join and hold the manager role (persons or coworker agents,
not the owner).

items.description: An external identity: k2:principal:<uuid>, k2:workspace:<uuid>, k2:connect:<uuid>, k2:owner, k2:server (K2's server service owner), local:<handle>, link:<channel_id>:<base32> (a meeting link guest), app:<app_id> (an App's service owner) or erased:<member_id> (an erased member's tombstone id; never accepted as input).

slug.description: The slug; `dm` is reserved. The idempotency key of the create.
